sys_atf_test.name: Day-2 SAM: a refused push can still succeed on retry (telemetry must not satisfy idempotency)
sys_atf_test.description: A sam_push_outcome row carrying a request id must never satisfy the inbound endpoint's idempotency check. If it does, a push refused once — e.g. before pull-verify was configured — can never afterwards create a RITM: the retry is short-circuited and the caller is told it already correlated.

sys_atf_step.description: Assert test_mode is on before writing any fixture data.
Simulate step 1 of the failure sequence: a REFUSED push. Calls recordPushOutcome exactly as deny() does, with no lineage row and no RITM anywhere for this request id.

GUARD 1 (structural): the telemetry row must carry the request id in sam_request_ref and leave sam_request_id EMPTY. If sam_request_id is populated here, the partition that makes the required unique index implementable is broken, and clause 5 has something to collide with.

GUARD 2 (defence in depth): run clause 5's lookup verbatim for the refused request id. It must find NOTHING, so the retry falls through to the lineage write instead of returning a bogus already-correlated 200.
Assert no lineage row exists for the refused request id — the refusal must not have created correlation state of any kind.
sys_atf_step.inputs: table = x_fed_day2_ops_integration conditions = record_type=sam_lineage^sam_request_id=ATF-SAM-0006 assert = zero matching rows
